name: Axiom Bathyscaphe
description: A deep-submersion vessel rated for pressures that exceed anything the Great Lakes should contain. The fact that Axiom built a vehicle capable of diving to depths the lake doesn't officially have tells you everything. Crew of three, reinforced titanium pressure hull, external manipulators, and a sonar system that maps in three dimensions. Bathyscaphe missions are classified. The crews sign NDAs measured in decades. What they've seen down there stays down there.
propulsion: Electric thruster array, ballast control, emergency ascent system
autonomy: Human-operated, AI-assisted navigation and hazard detection
armament: None declared. The hull is rated for things that shouldn't exist at those depths.
common_usage: Deep lake research, classified survey operations, things Axiom doesn't talk about.
story_hooks: A Bathyscaphe surfaces after a mission with one crew member missing and the other two refusing to speak
The sonar data from a Bathyscaphe dive shows structures at the bottom of the lake that are too regular to be geological and too large to be human-made
